children: ChampionsGate Acquisition signed a Business Combination Agreement with Futuremain to create a Cayman Islands holding structure and list Pubco shares. The all-stock transaction provides $80 million of consideration to Holdco shareholders in Pubco shares valued at $10.00 each, via a two-step merger in which Holdco and then ChampionsGate become subsidiaries of Pubco. ChampionsGate shareholders will receive Pubco shares, with every eight rights converting into one Class A share prior to exchange, and no fractional shares issued. Related arrangements include a lock-up for certain Pubco holders and a registration rights agreement, alongside a planned 15% equity incentive pool, all subject to customary approvals and Nasdaq listing conditions.
